extensions.title: Call Transcripts
extensions.description: Transcribe a call on this Mac: you through the microphone, the others through what the Mac plays. Text only, kept in ~/.jevie/calls and in recall.
extensions.author: vlad-terin
extensions.readme:
# Call Transcripts

Transcribe a call on this Mac: you through the microphone, the others through what the Mac plays. Text only, kept in ~/.jevie/calls and in recall.

## Say

- “transcribe this call”
- “transcribe the standup”
- “stop transcribing”
- “my call transcripts”
